statjam.uk/potus

US Presidential Elections

Results for each election since 1948 with selected statistics

Big figures

59
Presidential elections have taken place since 1788
45
individuals, all men, have served as President (Grover Cleveland is recognised as both the 22nd and 24th President). In January 2021 Joe Biden became the 45th individual to serve as President and the 46th designated to the role.
24
Presidents served four years or less.
5
Presidents elected despite losing the popular vote (JQ Adams, Hayes, B Harrison, GW Bush, Trump).
1
President appointed without ever being elected (Ford).
19
Republican Party Presidents
17
Democrat Party Presidents

Figures per state per election are approximate and rounded-UP percentages.

Gerald Ford contested the 1976 election as President having replaced Richard Nixon who resigned. Lyndon Johnson contested the 1964 election as President in place of the assassinated John Kennedy.
